sources.title: Upgrade to Flask 3 · Issue #1801 · tiny-pilot/tinypilot · GitHub

entries.title: json.JSONEncoder and json.JSONDecoder removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Use app.json.provider or app.json module instead of json.JSONEncoder/JSONDecoder classes; remove custom json_encoder/json_decoder attributes from app/blueprint.
entries.quote: `json_encoder` and `json_decoder` attributes on app and blueprint, and the corresponding `json.JSONEncoder` and `JSONDecoder` classes, are removed.

entries.title: Session marked accessed for key-only ops (breaking)
entries.migration: Code that uses `in` or `len` on session may trigger access tracking changes; verify session behavior with deprecation warnings.
entries.quote: The session is marked as accessed for operations that only access the keys but not the values, such as `in` and `len`.

entries.title: escape and Markup import path deprecated (deprecation)
entries.migration: Import `escape` and `Markup` directly from `markupsafe` instead of `flask`.
entries.quote: Importing `escape` and `Markup` from `flask` is deprecated. Import them directly from `markupsafe` instead.

entries.title: Request.trusted_hosts moved to routing check (behavior)
entries.migration: No code change needed; `trusted_hosts` is now checked during routing instead of only via config.
entries.quote: `Request.trusted_hosts` is checked during routing, and can be set through the `TRUSTED_HOSTS` config.

entries.title: Config.from_prefixed_env added (feature)
entries.migration: New method to load config from environment variables with FLASK_ prefix; optional, no migration required unless using this feature.
entries.quote: Add `Config.from_prefixed_env()` to load config values from environment variables that start with `FLASK_` or another prefix.

All these must be migrated in one pass to allow imports to succeed.
